rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a commemorative anniversary date.

example.english: We celebrate our wedding anniversary on this date every year.
example.traditional: 我哋每年都會喺呢日慶祝結婚紀念日。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 hai2 ni1 jat6 hing3 zuk1 git3 fan1 gei2 nim6 jat6

rows.note: Use this when the number of years is foregrounded, as in an event's tenth or fiftieth anniversary.

example.english: Our company is celebrating its thirtieth anniversary this year.
example.traditional: 公司今年慶祝成立三十周年。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 hing3 zuk1 sing4 lap6 saam1 sap6 zau1 nin4

rows.note: Use this explicit form when you want to stress that the date is the yearly commemoration itself.

example.english: Today is the tenth anniversary of our opening.
example.traditional: 今日係我哋開業十周年紀念日。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 hoi1 jip6 sap6 zau1 nin4 gei2 nim6 jat6
